Subject: Post-call recap & next steps - security kickoff and stakeholder mapping

Thanks again for your time earlier today - really good conversation and appreciate the clarity on your priorities. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Business need: you want predictable inference cost and a secure private deployment option for patient-data-adjacent workflows.
- Key decision criteria you mentioned: SLA/uptime, data residency, SOC2 evidence, and predictable unit economics for peak inference.
- Immediate ask: security review kickoff + questionnaire intake so our Security team can validate controls and confirm scope.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Alicia / Orchard to share the stakeholder map for security, legal, and procurement (names + roles + decision authority) - useful for us to surface the economic buyer and procurement timelines.
2) We'll kick off a 30-min security intake with our Security lead (Neha) to walk the questionnaire and confirm systems in scope.
3) I'm attaching a copy of the questionnaire for intake so you can pre-populate answers if helpful.

Attachments: Orchard-Questionnaire-v1.xlsx (questionnaire for intake)

Would you be able to share the stakeholder list today or tomorrow? If so, Neha can be available early next week for the intake.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Director, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Hi Alicia / Marissa - thanks for looping me in. I can run the 30-min intake tomorrow (Tue 24 Mar) at 9:30am PT - that works.

A few clarifying notes ahead of the call so we're efficient:
1) Confirmed systems in scope from our perspective: Orchard web app (backend APIs), partner public APIs, and S3 buckets for logs and model inputs. Please indicate whether the S3 buckets include any stored PHI (you noted "PHI scrubbed upstream" - we'll need confirmation of the scrub process).
2) Artifacts we typically request during intake: SOC 2 report (if available), network/architecture diagram showing controls between Redwood and Orchard systems, data flow for model inputs and telemetry, KMS/HSM usage details, and retention policy for logs/model inputs.
3) Questionnaire intake: we reviewed Orchard-Questionnaire-v1.xlsx and highlighted a few follow-ups (questions 8, 12, and 19 need extra context). If you can pre-fill those before the call it will speed things up.

I attached a simple stakeholder mapping we use to align reviewers; please review and let me know if anyone else should be included.

Attachment: MAP-stakeholders.pdf

See you tomorrow at 9:30am PT - I will send a calendar invite in a separate message.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
